about: A simple tool for watching your servers and keeping track of when their plans run out.

prs.title: Month-end renewal dates stay in the right month
prs.broken: A plan ending on the 31st renewed into the next month, like Oct 31 becoming Dec 1, and stayed late from then on.
prs.changed: Renewals now land on the last day of the target month when that day does not exist.
prs.matters: Expiry dates and their reminders stay on time.
